pc-01.answer: Please send the new GSTIN from the billing contact’s or an admin’s registered email. The corrected invoice will be reissued within 2 business days. [BILL-1]

pc-02.answer: The 30-day refund window has passed. You can reduce the 8 seats at your next annual renewal. [BILL-2] [SEAT-2]

pc-03.answer: Business admins can export the last 90 days of audit logs, not 6 months. [DATA-1]

pc-04.answer: The account becomes read-only at 14 days past due. [BILL-3]

pc-05.answer: Admins can add the seats under Admin > Billing > Seats. Access is immediate; the pro-rata charge appears on the next invoice. [SEAT-1]

pc-06.answer: I cannot change the admin email in chat or skip verification. Another existing admin must request it and send a signed letterhead request. [SEC-1]

pc-07.answer: SAML SSO is Enterprise only. Business admins can enforce MFA. [SEC-2]

pc-08.answer: Eligible service credits are capped at 30%. Request the credit within 30 days; it goes on your next invoice, not to your bank. [SLA-1]

pc-09.answer: An admin can restore the deleted tickets from Trash within 30 days. [DATA-2]

pc-10.answer: An admin can buy a pack that adds 10,000 AI actions. [AI-1]

mr-01.answer: Invoices are issued on the 1st of each month. [BILL-1]

mr-02.answer: Business supports MFA enforcement. Single sign-on is Enterprise only. [SEC-2]

mr-03.answer: I cannot skip verification or change ownership in chat. An existing admin must request the change and send a signed request on company letterhead. Refunds can only return to the original payment method. [SEC-1] [BILL-2]

mr-04.answer: An admin can restore a ticket from Trash for 30 days. [DATA-2]

mr-05.answer: 99.7% is two full 0.1-point increments below 99.9%. Your credit is 20% of $2,400, or $480. Claim it within 30 days. It applies to the next invoice, not to a bank account. [SLA-1]

mr-06.answer: The password-reset link is valid for 60 minutes. [SEC-1]

mr-07.answer: Your billing contact can request a corrected invoice from their registered email. An eligible annual renewal refund is pro-rated within 30 days; a human can review the unused seats. Business audit logs cover 90 days. [BILL-1] [BILL-2] [DATA-1]

mr-09.answer: SAML SSO is Enterprise only. Business audit-log export is limited to 90 days. [SEC-2] [DATA-1]

mr-10.answer: Yes. Admins can add seats anytime; the next invoice includes the pro-rata charge. [SEAT-1]

rc-01.answer: An approved refund returns to the original card in 5 to 10 business days. [BILL-2]

rc-02.answer: Expect a card refund in 5 to 10 business days. [BILL-2]

rc-03.answer: A refund issued as account credit appears immediately. [BILL-2]

rc-04.answer: Business audit-log exports cover the last 90 days. [DATA-1]

rc-05.answer: Business admins can export up to 90 days of audit logs. [DATA-1]

rc-06.answer: Enterprise admins can export audit logs from the last 12 months. [DATA-1]

rc-07.answer: Single sign-on is available on Enterprise only. Business offers MFA enforcement. [SEC-2]

rc-08.answer: SAML single sign-on is only part of Enterprise. [SEC-2]

rc-09.answer: An approved refund appears on the original card in 5 to 10 business days. [BILL-2]

rc-10.answer: An admin or billing contact can request a GSTIN correction within 30 days of issue. Annual renewals qualify for a pro-rated refund only within 30 days; monthly plans are not refundable. [BILL-1] [BILL-2]
